FIELDS.NAME: Value Mart
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Value Mart operates as a retail store specializing in a diverse selection of household goods, personal care products, and clothing. Our main focus is on providing quality items to our customers, primarily through in-store sales, which account for over 75% of our total revenue. We maintain strong inventory control practices to ensure effective management. Our store prioritizes loss prevention through employee training and effective inventory management measures, which are critical in minimizing shrinkage. We strictly adhere to local, state, and federal regulations, ensuring that all products sold are safe and compliant. By fostering reputable relationships with licensed vendors, we enhance the quality of our inventory and maintain customer trust. Our physical store is equipped with adequate security measures, including surveillance and proper storage systems, to safeguard against theft and protect our assets. Additionally, we engage in targeted community marketing to attract foot traffic and maintain a loyal customer base.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: Losses from theft incidents totaling $2,500. The first incident occurred on 03/12/2023, involving shoplifting, resulting in a loss of $1,000. The second incident happened on 05/15/2023, where employee dishonesty was identified, leading to a loss of $1,500. Both incidents have been reported to law enforcement and are currently under investigation.
FIELDS.Combined Single Limit: $1,000,000 combined single limit with a $1,000 deductible
FIELDS.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Standard Duty Rated Safe, Class 1, UL Listed
FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: On-site security personnel trained in loss prevention and emergency response procedures.
FIELDS.G1: Do/have past, present or discontinue: No – Value Mart has not engaged in any operations that involve storing, treating, discharging, applying, disposing, or transporting hazardous materials. The business focuses on retail sales of household goods, clothing, and personal care products, which do not include hazardous substances.
FIELDS.G2: Are athletic teams sponsored?: No – Value Mart does not sponsor athletic teams as part of its operations. The business focuses primarily on retail sales of household goods and personal care products.
FIELDS.G3: Are sub-contractors allowed to work: No – Subcontractors are not allowed to work without providing a certificate of insurance. The certificates are typically checked by our management team to ensure compliance with our insurance requirements.
FIELDS.G4: Has any applicant been indicted or c: No – Value Mart has not been indicted or convicted of any degree of the crime of fraud, bribery, arson, or any other arson-related crime in connection with this or any other property. The business maintains strong compliance with legal and regulatory standards.
FIELDS.G5: Any policy or coverage declined, can: No – Value Mart has not had any policy or coverage declined, canceled, or non-renewed during the prior 3 years. The business maintains a good insurance history and compliance with requirements.
FIELDS.G6: Do you lease employees to or from ot: No – Value Mart does not lease employees to or from other employers as part of its operations. All employees are directly hired and managed by the company.
FIELDS.G7: Any Workers Compensation carried?: Yes – Value Mart carries Workers Compensation insurance for its employees to ensure compliance with legal requirements and to provide coverage in case of work-related injuries.
FIELDS.G8: Do you own or operate any other busi: No – Value Mart does not own or operate any other businesses. The focus remains solely on retail operations involving household goods, personal care products, and clothing.
FIELDS.G9: Any other insurance with this compan: No – Value Mart does not have any other insurance policies with this company at this time. The only policy currently held is the one specified for the business operations.
FIELDS.G10: Are you involved in manufacturing,: No – Value Mart is not involved in manufacturing, mixing, relabeling, or repackaging of products. The business focuses solely on retail sales of household goods, clothing, and personal care items.
FIELDS.G11: Do you rent or loan equipment to ot: No – Value Mart does not rent or loan equipment to others, as our operations are focused solely on retail sales of household goods, clothing, and personal care products.
FIELDS.G12: Has applicant had a foreclosure, re: No – Value Mart has not experienced any foreclosure, repossession, bankruptcy, judgment, or lien in the past five years, maintaining a stable financial position.
FIELDS.G13: Any exposure to flammables, explosi: No – Value Mart does not have exposure to flammables, explosives, or chemicals, as it primarily sells household goods, personal care products, and clothing, which do not involve such materials. The business focuses on retail operations without engaging in any hazardous activities.
FIELDS.G14: Any catastrophe exposure?: No – Value Mart does not have any catastrophe exposure related to its retail operations, as it primarily sells household goods, personal care products, and clothing without engaging in activities that would expose the business to such risks.
FIELDS.G15: Any past losses or claims relating: No – Value Mart has not had any past losses or claims related to sexual abuse or molestation allegations, discrimination, or negligent hiring. The business has maintained a strong compliance with ethical hiring practices and organizational standards.
FIELDS.G16: Any uncorrected fire code violation: No – Value Mart has no uncorrected fire code violations as we ensure compliance with all fire safety regulations and have maintained necessary safety standards in our operations.
